18666116
AMENDMENTS TO THE CLAIMS
This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:
1. (Currently Amended) An apparatus for generating cardiac catheterization data, wherein the apparatus comprises: at least a processor; and a memory communicatively connected to the at least a processor, wherein the memory contains instructions configuring the at least a processor to: receive a plurality of cardiogram training data examples; sanitize the plurality of cardiogram training data examples, wherein sanitizing the plurality of cardiogram training data examples comprises: identifying one or more cardiogram training data examples of the plurality of cardiogram training data examples which are outliers; and removing the one or more cardiogram training data examples from the plurality of cardiogram training data examples; train a catheter data predictor using the sanitized plurality of cardiogram training data examples; input a plurality of cardiogram data signals; generate a plurality of catheterization parameters from the cardiogram data signals and the catheter data predictor; and display the plurality of catheterization parameters.
2. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the apparatus is further configured to refine a plurality of cardiogram examples comprises by: training a recognition classifier with cardiogram data examples comprising a plurality of cardiogram data correlated to a plurality of textbook validators of cardiac catheterization parameters; inputting the plurality of cardiogram training data examples into the recognition classifier; and outputting, by the recognition classifier, the plurality of cardiogram data signals and preliminary cardiac catheterization data.
3. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein training the catheter data predictor using the plurality of cardiogram training data examples comprises: training a comparison function classifier with a plurality of training data correlated to the plurality of cardiogram training data examples indicating inconsistencies between the plurality of training data and the plurality of cardiogram training data examples; inputting the plurality of training data into the comparison function classifier; and outputting, by the comparison function classifier, prediction of the plurality of catheterization parameters.
4. (Original) The apparatus of claim 3, wherein the catheter data predictor further comprises at least a neural network.
5. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 4, wherein the at least a neural network comprises at least a deep learning network.
6. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the at least a processor is configured to input [[a]] the plurality of cardiogram data signals by obviating at least right heart catheterization parameters.
7. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the plurality of cardiogram training data examples is correlated with ECG and Echocardiogram measurements.
8. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein generating [[a]] the plurality of catheterization parameters from the plurality of cardiogram data signals and the catheter data predictor comprises: training a prognosis classifier with training data correlating cardiac catheterization data signals data to a plurality of cardiac catheterization data; inputting the cardiac catheterization data signals into the prognosis classifier; and outputting, by the prognosis classifier, one or more cardiac catheterization data parameters indicating accordance and discordance.
9. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the plurality of catheterization parameters comprise at least one cardiac right heart catheterization parameter.
10. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein receiving [[a]] the plurality of cardiogram training data examples comprises retrieving the plurality of cardiogram training data examples from an electronic health record.
11. (Currently Amended) A method for generating cardiac catheterization data, wherein the method comprises: receiving, by at least a processor, a plurality of cardiogram training data examples; sanitizing, by the at least a processor, the plurality of cardiogram training data examples, wherein sanitizing the plurality of cardiogram training data examples comprises: identifying one or more cardiogram training data examples of the plurality of cardiogram training data examples which are outliers; and removing the one or more cardiogram training data examples from the plurality of cardiogram training data examples; training, by the at least a processor, a catheter data predictor using the sanitized plurality of cardiogram training data examples; inputting, by the at least a processor, a plurality of cardiogram data signals; generating, by the at least a processor, a plurality of catheterization parameters from the cardiogram data signals and the catheter data predictor; and displaying, by the at least a processor, the plurality of catheterization parameters.
12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 11, wherein the method further comprises refining a plurality of cardiogram examples comprises by: training a recognition classifier with cardiogram data examples comprising a plurality of cardiogram data correlated to a plurality of textbook validators of cardiac catheterization parameters; inputting the plurality of cardiogram training data examples into the recognition classifier; and outputting, by the recognition classifier, the plurality of cardiogram data signals and preliminary cardiac catheterization data.
13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 11, wherein training the catheter data predictor using the plurality of cardiogram training data examples comprises:
training a comparison function classifier with a plurality of training data correlated to the plurality of cardiogram training data examples indicating inconsistencies between the plurality of training data and the plurality of cardiogram training data examples; inputting the plurality of training data into the comparison function classifier; and outputting, by the comparison function classifier, prediction of the plurality of catheterization parameters.
14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein the catheter data predictor further comprises at least a neural network.
15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 14, wherein the at least a neural network comprises at least a deep learning network.
16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 11, wherein the method further comprises inputting [[a]] the plurality of cardiogram data signals by obviating at least right heart catheterization parameters.
17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 11, wherein the plurality of cardiogram training data examples is correlated with ECG and Echocardiogram measurements.
18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 11, wherein generating a plurality of catheterization parameters from the plurality of cardiogram data signals and the catheter data predictor comprises: training a prognosis classifier with training data correlating cardiac catheterization data signals data to a plurality of cardiac catheterization data; inputting the cardiac catheterization data signals into the prognosis classifier; and outputting, by the prognosis classifier, one or more cardiac catheterization data parameters indicating accordance and discordance.
19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 11, wherein the plurality of catheterization parameters comprise at least one cardiac right heart catheterization parameter.
20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 11, wherein receiving [[a]] the plurality of cardiogram training data examples comprises retrieving the plurality of cardiogram training data examples from an electronic health record.
